gloss: deep in the mountains, remote mountain area

definitions.gloss: deep in the mountains, remote mountain area
definitions.explanation: A place far into the mountains, typically remote and difficult to access. Implies seclusion and distance from civilization.

examples.japanese: {山奥|やまおく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a hot spring deep in the mountains.
The village deep in the mountains doesn't have a single shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山奥|やまおく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一人|ひとり}{暮|く}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather lives alone deep in the mountains, and even just going shopping is a challenge.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ (mountain) and ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧ (interior, deep part). Emphasizes remoteness and seclusion more than ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ alone. Often used to describe locations where traditional ways of life persist or where nature remains untouched.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山奥|やまおく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧: mountain village deep in the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live deep in the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分|わ}け{入|い}る: to venture deep into the mountains
- {山奥|やまおく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧: hot spring deep in the mountains
